hero.subtext: GigBridge helps businesses hire freelancers in Vietnam and connects specialists with ideal freelance opportunities in a transparent workflow.

about.animatedTitle:
Connect skilled talent
with modern projects
about.subtext1: Not another basic freelancing board — a trusted connection engine.
about.subtext2: Gigbridge bridges the gap between expert talent and businesses looking to build high-quality solutions, combining contract protection, secure milestones, and smart matching.

features.sectionDesc: Immerse yourself in a unified ecosystem where freelancers build reputations and clients find elite talent without friction.
features.matchmakingDesc: Our smart matchmaking engine connects freelancer profiles with appropriate project demands based on skills and history.
features.escrowDesc: Milestone-based escrows and secure wallets ensure developers get paid for approved work and clients receive quality delivery.
features.contractsDesc: Protect your collaboration with legally-binding, digital e-signed contract templates built directly into the workflow.
features.aiPilotDesc: AI interview screening tools and assistants help screen candidates and draft detailed project scopes quickly.
features.workspaceDesc: Unified workspace for real-time tracking, direct messaging, and milestone approval.
